title: Waiting for restocks during order reservation
name: Restock reservation waiter

locateQuestion.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code manages the lifetime of objects it registers or allocates per reservation? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
locateQuestion.explanation: The timeout callback in reserve() sets settled and rejects but never calls this.events.off(channel, onRestock). Every reservation that times out leaves its listener (and its closure over sku, qty, resolve/reject) attached to the long-lived emitter. For a SKU that stays out of stock, listeners pile up forever; setMaxListeners(0) silences the warning that would normally flag this, and each later restock event invokes every dead listener (they return early, but are still retained and called). The fix is to remove the listener in the timeout path too.

choiceQuestions.prompt: A SKU is out of stock and three reservations for it are waiting. A restock adds enough units for exactly one of them, and notifyRestock is called once. What happens?
choices: All three listeners run; each tries repo.decrement, one succeeds and resolves, the other two keep waiting
Only the first listener registered runs, because emit stops after the first handler that resolves
All three reservations resolve, because the restock event is broadcast to every waiter
None resolve until the next call to reserve() for that SKU
choiceQuestions.explanation: EventEmitter.emit calls every listener on the channel. Each onRestock calls repo.decrement; only the one whose decrement returns true resolves and removes itself, the others stay registered. emit does not stop after one handler, waiters are not resolved without a successful decrement, and there is no dependence on a later reserve() call.

choiceQuestions.prompt: Why does the constructor call this.events.setMaxListeners(0)?
choices: It removes the default 10-listener warning so many concurrent waiters on one SKU do not log MaxListenersExceededWarning
It limits each channel to a single listener
It causes listeners to be removed automatically after they fire once
choiceQuestions.explanation: Node warns when more than 10 listeners attach to one event name; setMaxListeners(0) disables that limit, allowing many waiters per SKU without warnings. It does not change emit timing, does not cap listeners at one, and does not make listeners one-shot (that is once()).

choiceQuestions.prompt: In OrderReservationService.reserveOrder, an order has lines A and B. A is reserved immediately; B waits and then fails with StockUnavailableError. What is the state afterwards?
choices: Both A and B are decremented and the order is marked reserved
Neither line is decremented because reserveOrder runs in a transaction
A's stock remains decremented, B is not, and the order is marked backordered on B
The StockUnavailableError propagates to the caller and the order is not updated
choiceQuestions.explanation: Lines are reserved one by one; nothing releases A's decrement when B fails. The catch block handles StockUnavailableError by calling markBackordered(orderId, err.sku) and returning false. There is no transaction, B is never decremented, and the error is not rethrown.
